title: Genus-3 Faltings-Hriljac heights
objective: Implement a bounded reference Faltings-Hriljac height and regulator engine for odd-degree genus-3 hyperelliptic Jacobians with explicit local capability diagnostics

oracles: exact finite intersection and graph-lattice self checks

handoff.summary: Implemented a bounded ordinary-Python genus-3 Faltings--Hriljac reference engine: exact regular-model matrix validation and Cox--Zucker vertical solves; certified semistable graph and irreducible-nodal theorem paths; exact rational-section intersections; split-Mumford factorization and Holmes moving representatives; complete finite candidate-prime plans with supplied certified overrides and structured unsupported records; Muller theta Green functions with refinement witnesses; the frozen periods/Abel--Jacobi adapter; global pairing, canonical-height, pairing-matrix, and regulator assembly. The automatic theta envelope is odd-degree genus-3 QQ, rational infinity, split rational Mumford degree three. Lower Mumford degrees retain finite and supplied-archimedean support but explicitly reject the currently special theta move.
risks: The current local-reduction cluster certificates do not encode full regular-model incidence/blow-up matrices or section-to-component maps. Reducible semistable fibres therefore need a separately certified matrix/component witness; the module never infers one from toric Euler data.
The archimedean result is numerical and non-rigorous: theta radius refinement is checked, but period, Abel--Jacobi, truncation, and rounding errors are not enclosed.
Automatic archimedean integration depends on bsd-periods and must be exercised after integration merges that lane. No independent Magma end-to-end height receipt is claimed in this isolated lane.

Bad reduction at p=2 and rational sections meeting singular plane-fibre points require supplied certified local pairings. Mature integer factorization is guarded by an input-size cap, not a wall-clock cancellation mechanism.
Broad native, SEA, and Wasm suites were intentionally deferred to centralized integration at the integration owner's request.
next_steps: Merge bsd-periods first, then run one automatic split degree-three odd-model example against Magma CanonicalHeight and check two independent moving fibres.
Expose the selected classes/functions through the centrally owned hyperelliptic public API and attach the finite/archimedean provenance to the BSD quotient result.
Extend local certificates with certified regular-model intersection matrices and section component maps for reducible split-cluster fibres, then widen the theta move for Mumford degree one and two.
Replace numerical theta refinement by ball-enclosed periods, Abel--Jacobi integrals, theta tails, and determinant/regulator arithmetic when a rigorous analytic backend is available.
